art_direction: Dark premium editorial, clinical precision meets luxury. Awwwards-style typography-driven design, minimal glare, high contrast hierarchy, deep space backgrounds with vivid restrained accents derived from the multi-colored teeth logo.

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Old Money Tech - High contrast serif for editorial elegance mixed with geometric sans for clinical clarity.

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl tracking-tighter leading-[0.9]

colors.gradients: Do not use cheap flat gradients. Instead, use massive, blurred, low-opacity radial gradients (auras) in the deep background representing the rainbow tooth logo colors.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-8 to p-24 for padding, gap-8 to gap-16 for grids.

grid_modes.bento_marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Highly asymmetric. Spans like col-span-8 row-span-2 for hero items, col-span-4 for secondary.
grid_modes.editorial_list: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-x-8 gap-y-16 border-t border-white/10 pt-8

motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY. Standard browser scroll breaks the premium feel.

animations.kinetic_hero: Framer Motion line-by-line reveal with overflow-hidden wrappers on text. y: 100% to 0%. duration: 0.8s, ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1].
animations.parallax: Framer Motion useScroll + useTransform for subtle image y-axis translation on scroll. Images should move at different speeds.
animations.marquee: react-fast-marquee. Very slow, smooth drift. Editorial ribbon style with Cormorant Garamond italic, massive gaps between items (gap-32), low opacity text.

visual_enhancers.textures: Include a fixed, pointer-events-none noise/grain overlay spanning the entire viewport at 3% opacity to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.cards: Do not use solid borders. Use 1px inner stroke border-white/5 with a dark surface bg. Hover state brings a subtle glow or -translate-y-1.
visual_enhancers.images: Real photography treated deliberately. Use spotlight effect or clipped architectural frames (tall and narrow, or perfect squares). Black and white conversion on hover or vice versa.

components_to_build.KineticHero: Deep dark background. Massive H1 typography line-by-line mask reveal. Subtle, slow-moving blurred orbs of the logo's rainbow colors in the far background. No 3D models, just floating depth.
components_to_build.ManifestoSection: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03). Massive high-contrast numbers in serif, aligned with short, powerful mission statements.
components_to_build.ServicesBento: Bento grid of services. Each block features a subtle hover state where a specific brand color (orange, teal, etc.) lightly glows from the bottom.
components_to_build.TeamSpotlight: 4 vertical cards for doctors. Grayscale photos that turn full color on hover. Include name, degrees, specialty.
components_to_build.LocationsBlock: Clean dual-column layout for the two units. Include address, exact phone numbers, and a sleek 'Call Now' pill button.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as flat gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and parallax.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers, never just transparent.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Add transitions to specific properties only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Provide design implementation in standard React .js or .jsx, not .tsx unless strictly required.

accessibility.focus_states: High contrast ring offset on focus.
accessibility.contrast: Text must meet WCAG AA against #0A0A0B.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling parallax where necessary.
